sections.text: So before we get to Science or Fiction, Cara, every year, when we do this review, a fan sends us a mashup of one of the rogues, of like, the funniest things that they said throughout the year. And this year, it was your turn!
Right!
(Laughs) You've been mashed.
'Cause everyone else has been done before, so, and you're the new rogue. So, let's take a listen to what they've got.
Back at my house, we would call that a Dad joke, which is complete and total horseshit.
Peenas
(Butthead laugh)
I could probably handle Jon Ham.
It's bullshit.
But a lotta people just think she's a bitch.
Peenas – hee hee!
Oliver Sacks said, “Shit, no more crazier than a jackall, am I right?”
Let's not forget, entertainers with vaginas.
Gah! Dern it!
He would have contaminated the shit out of the red planet!
Duct tape is magic, and should be worshiped.
All I got to say to that is like, climate change, yo.
It's good that they didn't call them the Mad Habberdashers.
Yep, another week, another poop story.
I get non-fat milk so I can add whip.
They call them crips.
I might be Googling him right now.
A good argument should be like sex, it shouldn't be just masturbating.
I wonder how male my brain is.
Your DVR must be so boring.
PEENAS.
You have been mashed.
(Rogues laugh)
That was awesome!
That's so mature.
I don't know how he pulls that off – how does he pull that off? Think about the work that would be involved. Unless he does it, every episode he listens to, he saves little snippets.
Well, that's the way to do it, of course.
Absolutely!
Yeah, that's the only way.
I don't know, I loved 'em too, 'cause they were all really random. Apparently I just say a lot of weird shit.
I love these. These mashups are like a rite of passage; it's very, very cool, I think.
Yeah, so that was from Jason Ferber. Jason's been making those for us every year. So thanks, Jason, we really appreciate that.
Yeah, thanks Jason.
Thanks Jason!
Guys
Yeah?
Let's go on to Science or Fiction.

Item #1: Scientists have discovered an organism that has not evolved detectably in over 2 billion years.
Item #2: A new study finds that people get more trusting as they get older.
Item #3: A new study changes the estimate for the evolution of eukaryotes from a maximum of 2.8 billion years ago to 3.5 billion years ago.

Rogues explain where Forgotten Superheroes of Science came from. It was a consequence of people complaining about Rebecca covering “too many women” on This Day in History.
Monsanto has contacted both Cara and Steve, offering to pay them for their work. Both of them have turned down the offer because it would hurt their reputations.
